_note: woo-request-from-a-portal-dossier (hydra woo-citizen-journey C5), design D1 and D3. Seeds the Woo request case type the template library only offered: eight statuses, four result types (woo-case-type requires them), the intake properties and portal windows open in its first two statuses. The fixed uuid is what WooRequestIntake opens a resident's request on. case.wooRequest carries the request itself: what was asked, for which period, where it came from and the dossier it was started from, which the publish side reads to bring the decision back. Every reference is the fixed uuid of the row it names: OpenRegister refuses a slug in a uuid-format property, and on 30 Sep the first import skipped every row of this file for that reason.

wooRequest.title: Woo request
wooRequest.description: What the resident asked for in a Woo request, for which period, where the request came from (portal or pipelinq) and the dossier it was started from. Written once by WooRequestIntake.

onderwerp.description: What the request is about, in the resident's words.

periodeVan.description: Start of the period the request is about.

periodeTot.title: Period to
periodeTot.description: End of the period the request is about.

originReference.title: Origin reference
originReference.description: The ticket or other record the request came from.

collectionId.title: Source dossier
collectionId.description: The opencatalogi collection the request was started from, if any.

documentSoorten.title: Kinds of document
documentSoorten.description: Which kinds of document the resident is looking for. Each value is one of besluiten, rapporten, correspondentie or alles.

toelichting.title: Further explanation
toelichting.description: Anything else the resident wanted to tell us about the request.

verzoekerNaam.title: Requester name
verzoekerNaam.description: The name the resident gave when they sent the request. It is kept as given, so a later change to their profile does not rewrite the file.

verzoekerEmail.title: Requester e-mail address
verzoekerEmail.description: The address the resident gave when they sent the request, for the answer to this request.

verzoekerType.title: Requester kind
verzoekerType.description: Who the resident says they are asking as: burger, journalist or organisatie. It is what they chose, not a judgement we make.
